description: Leave a request in the Squatch Stack inbox: a custom shirt or piece, details or an update on something, help with an order, or anything else. A person reads every one and answers from hello@squatch.cc if an email address is given. Returns a reference (SQ-XXXXXX) to check with request_status. It sends no email and charges nothing; the request and the address are kept for 180 days, then deleted. Ask the person before sending their email address.

about.description: Optional: a product slug or an order reference this is about

contact.description: An email address for the answer. Only with the person's say-so.

kind.description: custom = make something; details = more about a product or service; update = news on something already asked; order = help with an order; other

message.description: What they want, in their words: what, how many, by when

name: request_custom
title: Send the studio a request
